controls.action: Nothing — tilt is the whole game
setup.versus-caption: {available} boards built for four balls — {count} drawn at random
setup.title: TILT BALL
howto.1.title: Roll
howto.1.body: Tilt to roll your ball across the board. It keeps rolling after you level off, so steer early.
howto.2.title: Reach the goal
howto.2.body: Get to the goal without dropping into a pit or crossing a laser.
howto.3.title: Two modes
howto.3.body: Story is a ladder of boards, each one unlocking the next. Versus puts every player on one board at once.
